details: AURA Scan is a web prototype that helps astronauts monitor their health. It uses live camera OCR to read medical-device displays, saves stable readings for review, and tracks health history. Recommendations draw on NASA and Canadian Space Agency resources. The platform includes English and Spanish interfaces and a guided simulation showing the journey from device readings to recommendations and a PDF report.
